svg.title: Speedup over StrictMath
svg.desc: StrictMath's time over vfdlibm's on common and mixed data. Intel Xeon Platinum 8573C (AVX-512): exp 6.72 / 3.49, expm1 4.03 / 3.03, log 4.12 / 2.38, log10 4.41 / 2.76, log1p 3.39 / 2.81, sinh 3.53 / 2.74, cosh 3.49 / 1.84, asin 2.31 / 2.08, atan 3.48 / 2.30, acos 2.21 / 1.90, atan2 2.72 / 2.08, hypot 2.16 / 1.18, pow 11.79 / 7.43. AMD EPYC 7763 (AVX2): exp 4.29 / 2.62, expm1 1.90 / 1.74, log 2.44 / 1.97, log10 2.30 / 1.86, log1p 1.95 / 1.56, sinh 2.12 / 1.68, cosh 2.20 / 1.71, asin 2.07 / 1.52, atan 1.77 / 1.51, acos 1.99 / 1.36, atan2 1.72 / 1.55, hypot 1.25 / 0.70, pow 4.88 / 4.28. Under 1 is slower than StrictMath: hypot 0.70.
